description:
Stop, pause, put to sleep or remove yourself (only you; the agent calling this tool). It returns as soon as the request is sent. One op per call:
- stop: {"op": "stop"}  (you stop at the end of this step, maybe before you get to answer; your stack is kept; someone must run aos-agent ctl start, then you carry on from there)
- pause: {"op": "pause"}  (you hold still after this step; someone must run aos-agent ctl resume; you cannot resume yourself)
- sleep now: {"op": "sleep"}  (you are stopped right away, even in the middle of this turn; aos-agent ctl wake or a daemon restart brings you back)
- remove: {"op": "rm"}  (you are taken off the daemon table right away; your stack is kept; only aos-agent ctl add brings you back). {"op": "rm", "purge": true} also deletes your stack (your history and everything in it) and cannot be undone.
Use it when your work is done or you must not go on. Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, PhaseBad, CtlRejected, DaemonMissing, InstanceMissing.

op.description: stop = after this turn, pause = hold after this step, sleep = now, rm = leave the daemon table now

purge.description: rm only: true also deletes your stack (cannot be undone)
